address: 63, Lane 85, Minde Road, North District, Tainan, Taiwan
bio: After a few years of critical acclaim and commercial success, the owner-chef couple moved to this three-storey terraced house with a warm-hued façade and pebble garden. The rotating menu showcases the best seasonal ingredients, juggling Taiwanese and European flavours. The starch course, usually dumplings or risotto, references their Taiwanese roots. If you would like to see the chef in action, request seating on the ground floor.
